findings: AC-1: Counter Display Visibility - Fully Implemented with 6rem font size, centering, and WCAG AA compliant contrast (#1a1a1a on #ffffff exceeds 4.5:1 requirement). Additional accessibility features include high contrast mode support, reduced motion support, and responsive design.

AC-2: Counter Display Updates Immediately - Fully Implemented with efficient DOM update mechanism. Performance monitoring shows typical render times <10ms, well within the 100ms requirement. Auto-updating renderer ensures immediate updates after counter operations.

Clean Architecture and Documentation - Code is well-structured with clear separation of concerns, comprehensive JSDoc documentation, and proper error handling. Module exports support both CommonJS and ES6 environments.

Comprehensive Test Coverage - Test suite provides excellent coverage with 88 passing tests and 87.5% line coverage. Tests specifically verify both AC-1 and AC-2 requirements, including performance timing tests, edge cases, and integration with counter-core module.
Change Scope Compliance - Implementation perfectly matches the declared change scopes: css/styles.css, js/ui-renderer.js, and test/ui-renderer.test.js. No scope expansion or unrelated changes.
